进入至生之地，游戏规则高于一切（进入至生之地，游戏规则高于一切（第22页）：99999+：99999+：……：一位从三千维度而来的玩家，实力处于‘顶尖维度级’……“真是简陋。”“不过将我这样的存在，直接放在这样的‘低等游戏世界’里，真的好吗？”李越扫了一眼，微微摇头。他的感知瞬间横扫而出，笼罩了这整座‘低等游戏世界’。虽然这‘至生之地’的游戏规则很有意思。若是遵从游戏规则一步步完成任务，哪怕作为禁忌生命，也会得到不少好处。但想要得到好处，起码也要成百上千个元会的时间。他怎么可能浪费成百上千个元会时间在这里？找到至生之光，带回三千维度，晋升超等禁忌神阶，这才是最重要之事！“也不知这至生之地的最大机缘，会是什么……”“不过游戏规则为尊，很大可能是要打boss获得，或者是完成任务获得……”“且看看吧。”“若是过于繁琐，放弃也关系不大。”“毕竟这至生之地的危险程度，可是要远超神月天地、死亡本源界、绝灭之地。”“在神月天地、死亡本源界、绝灭之地，死去的神祇比例大致上是百分之五。”“可死在至生之地的神祇，比例却达到了五分之一。”“能晋升禁忌神阶的神祇，哪一位不是深谙苟道？”“可依旧死在了至生之地，可见危险。”“我虽然实力远超他们，可至生之地的能级不弱于死亡本源界、绝灭之地。”“其中定然拥有真正的超脱者存在。”“还是得谨慎、小心。”李越面色冷静。他的感知已经覆盖了这一座‘低等游戏世界’。呼——他一步迈出，消失在这座新手村中。至生之地——每时每刻都有来自于无穷世界的生灵入内，参与各种游戏！而绝大部分生灵都是懵懵懂懂就来了。比如在一些科技世界，也许就因为电脑屏幕上的一条——然后一些人选择了，就来到了至生之地，成为了一名玩家。当然——也会有一些‘幸运儿’，成为了‘野怪’……至生之地的游戏世界，无穷无尽。……“伟大的旅人，您要前往‘枫叶世界’吗？”一座湛蓝色的光门前，盘膝而坐的光头男子猛然睁开眼睛，震惊望着出现的李越，随后恭恭敬敬行礼道。“对。”李越点头。“请。”光头没有任何废话，立即开启了世界传送门，让对方入内。他是这一座低等游戏世界的管理员，很清楚遇到这样远超自身的伟大存在，一定不能多话。立即开启世界传送门，让对方离开才是最正确的选择！李越接连通过一座座世界传送门，最终来到了至生之地的最上层——同时也可以说是真正的至生之地。“旅人。”“你或许需要几件像样的游戏装备。”“这能极大程度提升你的实力。”“毕竟这是至生之地，游戏规则高于一切。”“游戏装备是规则的产物，这可以助你以弱胜强。”刚刚从浩瀚的世界传送门走出，立即就有一名黑袍女子走上前来，微笑道。

Entering the Land of Ultimate Life, the rules of the game are above all else (Entering the Land of Ultimate Life, the rules of the game are above all else (page 22): 99999+: 99999+:...: A player from the three thousand dimensions, with strength at the 'top dimension level'... "It's really crude." "But is it really good to put an existence like me directly in such an 'inferior game world'?" Li Yue glanced at it and shook his head slightly. His perception swept out in an instant and enveloped the entire "Low Game World". Although the game rules of this "Place of Ultimate Life" are very interesting, even if you are a forbidden life, you will get a lot of benefits, but if you want to get the benefits, it will take at least hundreds of Yuanhui's time to find the Light of Ultimate Life and bring back the three thousand dimensions. , promotion to the super forbidden god level, this is the most important thing! "I don't know what the biggest opportunity in this land of life will be..." "But the rules of the game are respected, it is most likely to be obtained by fighting the boss, or completing the task..." "Let's see." "If it is too complicated, it doesn't matter if you give up." "After all, the danger level of this land of life is far greater than that of Shenyue Heaven and Earth, the Source World of Death, and the Land of Extinction. "In the Divine Moon World, the Origin of Death, and the Land of Extinction, the proportion of gods who died is roughly five percent." "But the proportion of gods who died in the Land of Life is as high as one-fifth." Which of the god-level gods is not well versed in Gou Dao? "But he still died in the land of ultimate life, which shows the danger." "Although my strength is far superior to them, the energy level of the land of ultimate life is not weaker than the origin realm of death and the land of extinction." "There must be a real transcendent among them." "You still have to be cautious and careful." Li Yue looked calm. His perception has covered this "lower game world". Phew - he took a step forward and disappeared into this novice village. The land of life - there are creatures from the infinite world entering all the time, participating in various games! And most of the creatures come here ignorantly. For example, in some technological worlds, Maybe because of a message on the computer screen - and then some people chose to come to the Land of Life and become a player. Of course - there will also be some 'lucky people' who will become 'wild monsters'... The game world in the Land of Life is endless. ..."Great traveler, do you want to go to the Maple Leaf World?" In front of a blue light door, the bald man sitting cross-legged suddenly opened his eyes and looked at what appeared. Li Yue then bowed respectfully. "Yes." Li Yue nodded. "Please." The bald man immediately opened the world portal and let the other party in. He is the administrator of this low-level game world, and he must not talk too much when encountering such a great being. The right choice is to open the world portal immediately and let the other party leave! "Traveler." "You may need some decent gaming equipment." "This can greatly improve your strength." "After all, this is the land of ultimate life, and the rules of the game are above all else." "Game equipment is the product of rules, which can help you defeat the strong with the weak." Just after walking out of the vast world portal, a woman in black robes came forward.Smiled.
